entities.name: Ignacio Martín Goenaga
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ignacio Amadeo Martín Goenaga is a Spanish rugby sevens player. He competed at the 2016 Summer Olympics for the Spanish rugby sevens team. He was also part of the team that defeated Samoa 7s to earn the last spot for the Olympics.
